name: Article by PMID
cypher: MATCH (a:Article) WHERE a.pmid = '12345678' RETURN a.pmid, a.title, a.pub_year

name: Article by different PMID
cypher: MATCH (a:Article) WHERE a.pmid = '25000000' RETURN a.pmid, a.title

name: Article by PMID (recent)
cypher: MATCH (a:Article) WHERE a.pmid = '35000000' RETURN a.pmid, a.title, a.pub_year

name: Article by PMID (oldest)
cypher: MATCH (a:Article) WHERE a.pmid = '1' RETURN a.pmid, a.title

name: Articles by year
cypher: MATCH (a:Article) WHERE a.pub_year = 2020 RETURN a.pmid, a.title LIMIT 10

name: Article → Authors
cypher: MATCH (a:Article)-[:AUTHORED_BY]->(au:Author) WHERE a.pmid = '25000000' RETURN au.name

name: Article → MeSH terms
cypher: MATCH (a:Article)-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]->(m:MeSHTerm) WHERE a.pmid = '25000000' RETURN m.name

name: Article → Chemicals
cypher: MATCH (a:Article)-[:MENTIONS_CHEMICAL]->(c:Chemical) WHERE a.pmid = '30000001' RETURN c.name

name: Article → Journal
cypher: MATCH (a:Article)-[:PUBLISHED_IN]->(j:Journal) WHERE a.pmid = '25000000' RETURN j.title

name: Article → Grants
cypher: MATCH (a:Article)-[:FUNDED_BY]->(g:Grant) WHERE a.pmid = '20000000' RETURN g.grant_id, g.agency

name: Author → Articles (reverse)
cypher: MATCH (au:Author)<-[:AUTHORED_BY]-(a:Article) WHERE au.name = 'Arie Hasman' RETURN a.pmid, a.title LIMIT 10

name: MeSH → Articles (reverse)
cypher: MATCH (m:MeSHTerm)<-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]-(a:Article) WHERE m.name = 'Neoplasms' RETURN a.pmid LIMIT 10

name: Chemical → Articles (reverse)
cypher: MATCH (c:Chemical)<-[:MENTIONS_CHEMICAL]-(a:Article) WHERE c.name = 'Aspirin' RETURN a.pmid, a.title LIMIT 10

name: Journal → Articles (reverse)
cypher: MATCH (j:Journal)<-[:PUBLISHED_IN]-(a:Article) WHERE j.title = 'Nature' RETURN a.pmid LIMIT 10

name: Co-authors of an article
cypher: MATCH (a:Article)-[:AUTHORED_BY]->(au:Author)<-[:AUTHORED_BY]-(b:Article) WHERE a.pmid = '25000000' AND a <> b RETURN b.pmid, b.title LIMIT 10

name: Citation chain (who cites my citers)
cypher: MATCH (a:Article)<-[:CITES]-(b:Article)<-[:CITES]-(c:Article) WHERE a.pmid = '15000000' RETURN b.pmid, c.pmid LIMIT 10

name: Articles citing a specific article
cypher: MATCH (a:Article)<-[:CITES]-(b:Article) WHERE a.pmid = '20000000' RETURN b.pmid, b.title LIMIT 10

name: Articles cited by a specific article
cypher: MATCH (a:Article)-[:CITES]->(b:Article) WHERE a.pmid = '20000000' RETURN b.pmid LIMIT 10

name: MeSH co-occurrence (Neoplasms)
cypher: MATCH (m1:MeSHTerm)<-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]-(a:Article)-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]->(m2:MeSHTerm) WHERE m1.name = 'Neoplasms' AND m1 <> m2 RETURN m2.name, count(a) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10

name: MeSH co-occurrence (Diabetes)
cypher: MATCH (m1:MeSHTerm)<-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]-(a:Article)-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]->(m2:MeSHTerm) WHERE m1.name = 'Diabetes Mellitus' AND m1 <> m2 RETURN m2.name, count(a) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10

name: Chemical co-occurrence via articles
cypher: MATCH (c1:Chemical)<-[:MENTIONS_CHEMICAL]-(a:Article)-[:MENTIONS_CHEMICAL]->(c2:Chemical) WHERE c1.name = 'Aspirin' AND c1 <> c2 RETURN c2.name, count(a) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10

name: Author collaboration network
cypher: MATCH (au1:Author)<-[:AUTHORED_BY]-(a:Article)-[:AUTHORED_BY]->(au2:Author) WHERE au1.name = 'Arie Hasman' AND au1 <> au2 RETURN au2.name, count(a) AS papers ORDER BY papers DESC LIMIT 10

name: Top authors by paper count
cypher: MATCH (au:Author)<-[:AUTHORED_BY]-(a:Article) WHERE au.name STARTS WITH 'Smith' RETURN au.name, count(a) AS papers ORDER BY papers DESC LIMIT 10

name: Most cited articles (fan-in)
cypher: MATCH (a:Article)<-[:CITES]-(b:Article) WHERE a.pmid >= '20000000' AND a.pmid < '20001000' RETURN a.pmid, count(b) AS citations ORDER BY citations DESC LIMIT 10

name: Publication trend by year for a MeSH term
cypher: MATCH (m:MeSHTerm)<-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]-(a:Article) WHERE m.name = 'Machine Learning' RETURN a.pub_year, count(a) AS articles ORDER BY a.pub_year DESC LIMIT 20

name: Journals publishing most cancer research
cypher: MATCH (m:MeSHTerm)<-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]-(a:Article)-[:PUBLISHED_IN]->(j:Journal) WHERE m.name = 'Neoplasms' RETURN j.title, count(a) AS articles ORDER BY articles DESC LIMIT 10

name: Funding agencies for cancer research
cypher: MATCH (m:MeSHTerm)<-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]-(a:Article)-[:FUNDED_BY]->(g:Grant) WHERE m.name = 'Neoplasms' RETURN g.agency, count(DISTINCT a) AS papers ORDER BY papers DESC LIMIT 10

name: Articles with both MeSH and Chemical annotations
cypher: MATCH (a:Article)-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]->(m:MeSHTerm) WHERE m.name = 'Neoplasms' MATCH (a)-[:MENTIONS_CHEMICAL]->(c:Chemical) RETURN a.pmid, c.name LIMIT 10

name: Grant agencies funding diabetes research
cypher: MATCH (m:MeSHTerm)<-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]-(a:Article)-[:FUNDED_BY]->(g:Grant) WHERE m.name = 'Diabetes Mellitus' RETURN g.agency, count(DISTINCT a) AS papers ORDER BY papers DESC LIMIT 10

name: Most published journals overall
cypher: MATCH (j:Journal)<-[:PUBLISHED_IN]-(a:Article) WHERE j.title STARTS WITH 'N' RETURN j.title, count(a) AS articles ORDER BY articles DESC LIMIT 10

name: Chemical mentions in Nature articles
cypher: MATCH (j:Journal)<-[:PUBLISHED_IN]-(a:Article)-[:MENTIONS_CHEMICAL]->(c:Chemical) WHERE j.title = 'Nature' RETURN c.name, count(a) AS mentions ORDER BY mentions DESC LIMIT 10

name: MeSH terms for NIH-funded articles
cypher: MATCH (g:Grant)<-[:FUNDED_BY]-(a:Article)-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]->(m:MeSHTerm) WHERE g.agency = 'NCI NIH HHS' RETURN m.name, count(DISTINCT a) AS papers ORDER BY papers DESC LIMIT 10

name: Authors publishing in a specific journal
cypher: MATCH (j:Journal)<-[:PUBLISHED_IN]-(a:Article)-[:AUTHORED_BY]->(au:Author) WHERE j.title = 'Science' RETURN au.name, count(a) AS papers ORDER BY papers DESC LIMIT 10

name: Multi-MeSH article (articles with 5+ MeSH terms)
cypher: MATCH (a:Article)-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]->(m:MeSHTerm) WHERE a.pmid >= '30000000' AND a.pmid < '30000100' WITH a, count(m) AS mesh_count WHERE mesh_count >= 5 RETURN a.pmid, mesh_count ORDER BY mesh_count DESC LIMIT 10

name: Prolific authors in machine learning
cypher: MATCH (m:MeSHTerm)<-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]-(a:Article)-[:AUTHORED_BY]->(au:Author) WHERE m.name = 'Machine Learning' RETURN au.name, count(DISTINCT a) AS papers ORDER BY papers DESC LIMIT 10
